parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets appropriately. Sentence 5 now correctly distinguishes problem identification from implementation guidance, noting the comment lacks details on how to design the test or modify Eq. (5). Sentence 6 no longer makes the unsupported claim that authors know how to proceed. Sentence 7 correctly maps the evidence to an implicit, vague action without stating a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated correct reasoning (e.g., the observation about Eq. (5) using one data point and the implicit nature of the action) is preserved, and no fabricated evidence is introduced.
